note: Acceptance gates for a candidate snapshot (crawler/qa.py). Edit a value and the next pipeline run re-evaluates the held candidate (its gates.json records a hash of this file + sentinels.json + categories.json). A null threshold means measure-only: the gate is still measured and reported but can never hold a snapshot. Exception: dept_size_tolerance null only disables the page-count comparison; a department that did not finish or kept no items always fails departments_complete. sample_review.required false skips the Claude sample review and publishes on the deterministic gates alone.
